observations: Three photos show the same shipping container from slightly different angles, loaded with multiple used engines (roughly 10-12 units) stacked on cardboard-lined shelves in three rows.
No engine codes, stampings, VIN plates, or brand markings are legible on any engine in any photo.
Container/truck signage reads 'Yah Lateef', 'Carrozzeria Industriale M.Vele', with an Italian phone/fax number and 'mvele.it' - this identifies the shipping/transport company, not the engines.
A watermark reads 'G.O. Merchants Ltd' across photos 0-2.
Engines appear disassembled from vehicles (no harnesses, some missing accessories), consistent with used/salvage take-outs.
It is not clear whether the listing is for one single engine, a selection, or the entire container load.

identity.kind: used engine(s), multiple possible vehicle fitments claimed by seller (Lexus RX350/ES350/IS250, Toyota Camry, 2008-2015)

claims.evidence: No engine in photos 0-2 shows a readable code, casting mark, or tag confirming RX350 fitment.
Same - no identifying marks visible on any block.

risks.if_unproven: priced as lowest-value unidentified used engine in the group

risks.risk: Engine condition/working status (compression, mileage, no cracks, no overheating history) cannot be assessed from container photos.
risks.proof: Video of engine running or compression test result, plus close-up of block for cracks/leaks.

risks.risk: Whether the sale is for a single engine or the whole container lot is unclear, drastically changing the price basis.

risks.proof: Odometer photo from donor vehicle or auction sheet/import documentation.

response.reason: The photos show an unlabeled bulk lot of used engines with no readable codes or marks tying any single unit to the models the seller lists, and it is unclear whether one engine or the whole container is for sale, so even a worst-case price cannot be anchored to a specific item.
